 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. For those night owls willing to stick it out, this game starts at 10pm Jayhawk Time. Why is ESPN putting their elite matchup at 11pm eastern? Who knows. It's ESPN. If it's not SEC football they're barely aware it exists.
 Tyran Stokes is questionable for tonight, but given the low stakes and this being a non-con game in mid November, it seems unlikely that he'll suit up. With that being the case, Houston is a 3.5 point favorite.
 Will this thread get 50 posts? Is anyone on the east coast willing to stay up past 1am to watch this? These are the questions that will be answered tonight.
